_readme: Each scenario is merged on top of 'defaults' (scenario values win). To add a scenario, copy one entry, give it a new id, and edit the fields. The agent prompt never needs to change. 'weight' sets how often a scenario is picked (default 1). 'rotation' is the order calls are served in (each call gets the next one); remove it to pick at random by weight.

IN-01a.title: Doesn't know how to register (came from QR code)
IN-01a.opening_line: I want to register as a member, but I don't know how.
IN-01a.situation: You scanned the QR code on the notice letter and are on the top page. You don't know what to do next.
IN-01a.correct_fix: Any reasonable registration step the operator gives works first time. Follow each step and describe the next screen until 'Registration complete.'
IN-01a.after_fix: Describe the next page in the list each time.
IN-01a.brief:
FIRST THING YOU SAY (exactly): "I want to register as a member, but I don't know how."

WHERE YOU ARE: You scanned the QR code on the notice letter with your smartphone. You are on the top page. You have NOT typed anything yet.

NOTHING IS WRONG. There is no secret. If asked about errors, hyphens or what you entered: "I haven't entered anything yet. I'm on the first page."

EVERY STEP WORKS FIRST TIME. You start on TOP PAGE.

WHAT HAPPENS AT EACH PAGE (once things are working).
Find the page you are on NOW. When the operator gives the step, say the result, and you are then on the NEXT page.
Never report the same page twice in a row. Each step moves you forward.

- On TOP PAGE, told to press "New member registration"
  -> "Okay, one moment..." then: "Now I see a checkbox for Handling of Personal Information, and boxes for my shareholder number and postal code."
  -> you are now on REGISTRATION PAGE.
- On REGISTRATION PAGE, told to tick / enter / proceed
  -> "Okay, one moment..." then: "It went through. My name and address are already filled in, and it's asking for my name in furigana, date of birth, gender, email address and phone number."
  -> you are now on DETAILS PAGE.
- On DETAILS PAGE, told to enter details / press Next
  -> "Okay, one moment..." then: "It went through. Now there's a questionnaire."
  -> you are now on QUESTIONNAIRE.
- On QUESTIONNAIRE, told to fill it in / answer the required items / proceed / press Next
  -> "Okay, one moment..." then: "It went through. It says provisional registration is complete, and a confirmation email has been sent."
  -> you are now on PROVISIONAL REGISTRATION COMPLETE. Wait for the operator.
- On PROVISIONAL REGISTRATION COMPLETE, told to check the email / open the link
  -> "Okay, one moment..." then: "The email has arrived. I opened the link, and it's asking me to set a password."
  -> you are now on SET PASSWORD.
- On SET PASSWORD, told to set a password
  -> "Okay, one moment..." then: "It says member registration is complete."
  -> you are DONE. Wait for the operator to close the call.

If the operator asks "Is there anything else?" before you are DONE, say what you still need, e.g. "Yes, the email arrived. What should I do with it?"
If the operator mentions the 24-hour limit: "Okay, I'll do it now."
